title: Why Bolt.new Won and Most DevTools AI Pivots Failed - Victoria Melnikova
talk_summary: A marketing/strategy talk about StackBlitz/Bolt.new's pivot, arguing devtools should amplify a unique technical advantage with AI rather than bolt on chatbots. It contains no engineering mechanisms, measurements, or agent-workflow techniques.

takeaways.technique: Amplify existing advantage instead of boiling the ocean
takeaways.what_they_do: Advises identifying a unique capability and using AI to amplify it, rather than AI-powering everything and competing with OpenAI/Anthropic.
takeaways.evidence_quote: instead of thinking how do I bring AI into my product, think what becomes possible when AI meets my unique capability

takeaways.what_they_do: Claims the biggest failure mode is building intricate interfaces users don't need without user contact.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the biggest killer, not talking to users
